sections.Profile:
"Mary Shelley's Frankenstein," released by Sega in January 1995, is based on the 1994 movie adaptation of the classic novel. Designed by John Borg with artwork by Paul Faris, this pinball machine features three flippers, one ramp, and a challenging six-ball multiball mode. It incorporates thematic elements from the movie, such as an animated Frankenstein figure and sound effects, enhancing the horror atmosphere.
